# WORK-ID Implementation Plan Title

> **Status:** Planned | In Progress | Completed | Deferred | Blocked
> **Started date:** YYYY-MM-DD | N/A
> **Last updated:** YYYY-MM-DD
> **Completion date:** YYYY-MM-DD | N/A
> **Owner:** role or name
> **Milestone:** M1 | M2 | M3 | M4 | M5 | M6 | M7
> **Dashboard:** [IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md](../IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md)

---

## Outcome

State the observable outcome this work package must produce.

## Scope

List included behavior, systems, documents, and validation.

## Out Of Scope

List tempting but intentionally excluded work.

## Dependencies

List required prior work, decisions, tools, access, or gates.

## Module Status

| Module | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Module name | Not Started | Note |

Allowed module statuses: Not Started, In Progress, Completed, Deferred, Blocked.

## Implementation Plan

Describe the planned slices in dependency order.

## Validation

List commands, tests, manual checks, device checks, and evidence requirements.

## Evidence

Link accepted evidence after validation passes.

## Risks And Blockers

Record known risks, blockers, and resolution triggers.

## Decisions

Link ADRs or record small package-level decisions that do not need an ADR.

## Follow-Up

Record intentionally deferred work and the gate that should revisit it.
